decision: adapt (idea); rate limit fixed in sketch; scope and faction order listed as changes
rule: Zone alarm: when a guard or civilian enters combat with a player, or a guard dies to a player, the server sends a zone-under-attack message with the zone id to every open-world player of the opposite team. No cooldown or rate limit in the path read. Guard barks: one of three lines chosen by a uniform roll, repeats possible, no per-instance memory. Pet names: one random first half and one random second half from per-family pools, family name as fallback. Faction reaction: group enemy first, then explicit enemy, then group friend, then explicit friend, then reverse checks, then neutral; reputation overrides for player-controlled units. Text objects: 5.55556 yards interaction; page query walks Next_Page in a loop with no cycle guard.

look_test: On a 375-wide phone: (1) a guard-engagement alert shown three times in a row, then once after 60 s, to judge news versus spam; (2) the alert scoped to one zone and neighbours versus a whole-team alert; (3) guard barks as plain random versus no-repeat, 12 engagements each. Dom picks which reads as news and which reads as a guard who remembers.
